page.layout: One title page, all lines centred. A large title at the top, a smaller title block below it, a verse or motto in an engraved frame, a central woodcut, a printer's line at the foot. Handwriting near the bottom is excluded.
page.notes: Title page with a woodcut in the centre; no page number or running head. The top title is only partly legible at this scan size, and the frame text is largely illegible. The printer's imprint at the foot is doubtful. The brown handwritten note at the bottom right is excluded, as is the mirrored show-through near the right edge.
